result.summary: The page is generally well-designed, but the bottom restaurant card is cut off by the bottom navigation bar, and there is a large amount of empty white space between the cut-off card and the bottom navigation, making the layout look incomplete.

issues.description: The last restaurant card is cut off mid-image at the bottom of the scroll area, leaving a large awkward blank white gap between the truncated card and the bottom navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the content list scrolls properly under the bottom navigation or render a complete card; remove the empty white gap by letting content flow edge-to-edge behind/above the nav bar.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder text ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') is light gray on a light gray background, resulting in low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text color to improve readability and accessibility.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel is horizontally cut off ('Trattoria Piccol...' truncated at the screen edge), which is intentional for carousels but the truncated restaurant name provides no affordance indicating more content.
issues.suggestion: Consider adding a subtle visual cue (e.g., partial card spacing or scroll indicator) to signal horizontal scrollability.
